scope: CLI consumer docs, release-note rendering, published annotations and product explanations
compatibility: No command, exit-code, wire-plan or transaction behavior changed. SQLite diagnostic metadata replaces private owner_task with owner_component. Recorded PATH append bytes still drive removal; legacy-comment regression preserves user edits. Existing immutable release tags/assets untouched.
limitations: Read-only MacIntel output checks only; no native Windows/Linux lifecycle run or new release. Current release assets and remote release descriptions remain unchanged. The existing repair/concise-doctor runtime feature branch is retained separately.
negative_cases: Nested public docs/scripts/workflow labels; channel/script contamination; missing generated assets; duplicate Unreleased; moving/unknown tags. Bootstrap tests isolated from real installed CLI paths.
historical_traceability: Original public documents retained as internal .snapshot files; canonical completion uses an internal changelog receipt because public IDs are explicitly forbidden by the owner.
